# Lucide SVG subset

- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide-static/v/1.63.0
- Upstream: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
- Retrieved: 2026-10-28 (Asia/Seoul)
- Version: lucide-static 1.63.0
- `icons/`: unmodified official SVG sources used by SLUR.
- `LICENSE`: complete upstream license, including ISC and Feather-derived MIT notices. Copy alongside redistributed icons.

SLUR embeds the source geometry inline, removes fixed dimensions and upstream CSS classes, and adds `data-icon`, `aria-hidden` and `focusable`. No geometry is redrawn. See `references/icons.md` in the slur-design skill for use and selection rules.
